text:
margot: Heads-up from the quarterly recurrence pull 026-04: found two lower-frequency but repeatable patterns that are leaking remediation coverage across teams: 1) shared-storage multiplexing -> transient IO queuing -> tail token latency spikes; 2) regional rate-limiter mismatch causing cross-region fallback churn. Posting notes + suggested owners so we can close gaps.

kevin: Can you share the selection criteria you used so owners can validate signal vs noise?

margot: Sure, I started with closed incidents that had tags like 'io','storage','fallback','ratelimit' between 2026-01-01 and 2026-04-01 and looked for root_cause overlaps. Quick SQL I used:```sql
SELECT incident_id, root_cause, tags, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY root_cause) as freq
FROM incident_events
WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-04-01'
AND status = 'closed'
AND (tags @> ARRAY['io','storage'] OR tags @> ARRAY['ratelimit','fallback'])
ORDER BY freq DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

sandra: For shared-storage case, I can confirm three Dedicated incidents where concurrent tenant backups + model checkpoints saturated the NVMe controller queue. Result: per-request token latency p99 jumped and autoscaler misinterpreted load.

idar: Region mismatch case 1: we had config where EU rate-limiter windows were 2s and US were 500ms; cross-region failover caused clients to retry aggressively and trigger fallback churn.

kevin: Proposals: A) storage-side: add tenant-scoped IO reservations for checkpoint windows + stagger backup windows; owner: sandra. ETA: 2026-04-22. B) rate-limiter: unify region windows or add cross-region backoff policy; owner: idar + kevin. ETA: 2026-04-12.

margot: Also propose an infra alert for the storage pattern: STORAGE_IO_QUEUING_V1 when p99_token_latency > 1000ms AND nvme_io_queue_depth > threshold for 5m. Owner: ops to draft and canary. ETA ops: 2026-04-05.

ops-bot: Auto-note: incident 1850001110 had nvme_io_queue_depth peak=768 and p99_token_latency=1450ms over 7m. Recommended initial queue threshold=500.

sandra: I'll own IO reservations prototype. Plan: implement tenant-level cgroup for checkpoint threads and a small scheduler to stagger automated backups. Will test in staging Dedicated pool. ETA 2026-04-22.

idar: For rate-limiter, first step is a config audit to find divergent window values and client hinting behavior. I'll take audit + patch to add Retry-After semantics on cross-region redirects. Owner: idar. ETA 2026-04-08.

kevin: I'll pair on the unified policy and add a small compatibility layer so older clients still get exponential+jitter behavior. ETA 2026-04-12.

margot: Action recap (please react with :thumbsup: to accept):
- sandra: tenant IO reservations + backup staggers (ETA 2026-04-22)
- idar + kevin: rate-limiter audit + unified backoff + Retry-After semantics (ETA 2026-04-12)
- ops: create STORAGE_IO_QUEUING_V1 alert + canary (ETA 2026-04-05)
- margot: update patterns tracker and add 'cascade_entry' column with values (io|ratelimit|network|scheduler|other) (ETA 2026-04-03)

sandra: +1 :thumbsup: starting a small design doc now.

idar: +1. I'll open the audit PR and link it.

kevin: +1. Will draft compatibility notes for SDKs.

ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up sync 2026-04-14 09:00 PT.

margot: Also flagging a process gap: several PMR action rows for these clusters had owner=null or owner=unresponsive. Proposing a bi-weekly handoff sweep that lists actions with (owner is null OR last_update < now() - interval '21 days') and auto-notifies the oncall rotation. Owner: margot to prototype. ETA: 2026-04-06.

kevin: Good call. Can the sweep add a 'sweep_reason' tag and record sweep_ts + sweep_owner on the tracker row? That helps audit.

margot: Yes, will add sweep_owner and sweep_ts columns and a quick SLA: assigned within 5 business days or escalate to manager digest.

sandra: For IO reservations, success metric: reduce STORAGE_IO_QUEUING incidents by 75% in 30 days for flagged tenants. I'll include perf delta and rollback steps.

idar: For rate-limiter, success: cross-region fallback events down >60% in 30 days post-unified policy.

kevin: And we'll add a dashboard panel for cross-region retry rates per tenant.

ops-bot: Thread archived to incident-patterns index.
